**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Dictate Prompt
- **Type your instruction instead of speaking it.** Select text, press the Dictate Prompt shortcut and just start typing: the field under the quick-action list has focus right away. Press the shortcut again (or Return) to run what you typed. Leave the field empty and your spoken instruction is used, as before. While the field is empty, the arrow keys, Return and 1–5 still pick a quick action.
- The quick-action keys no longer grab Return, Esc, the arrow keys or number keys system-wide while you record.

## Chat
- **Mail accounts:** the server settings are filled in automatically from your domain's mail records, so most providers connect with just your address and password. Cancel stays available while the app checks the connection.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.32...v8.33
